data.name: Holospace
data.detailed_description:
Strap into a sleek shuttle, drop through a planet’s atmosphere, and step onto its surface. Then lift off, break orbit, and aim for another pinprick of light across the system. In Holospace, there are no loading screens between worlds—just one continuous procedural universe stretching as far as you are willing to fly.

One seamless journey, surface to space

Pilot your ship from the ground, through the atmosphere, into open space, and onward to the next planet—all in real time, without cutting to a loading screen. Land, leave your ship behind, and explore on foot as you run, sprint, jump, and jetpack across voxel terrain beneath changing skies, day-and-night cycles, and rolling weather.

A vast procedural universe

Every planet is shaped by its own seed, influencing its palette, gravity, terrain, biomes, oceans, weather, resources, and ecosystems. No two worlds are exactly alike.

Each planet draws from a growing library of distinct creature species, procedurally adapting their size, coloration, surface patterns, behavior, rarity, and habitat to create local fauna unique to that world.

Your home world is always waiting. Everything beyond it is yours to chart.

Mine, craft, and build

Carve into the terrain with a plasma cutter, gather increasingly valuable materials, and craft equipment at deployable stations using a shaped recipe grid. Place blocks, construct structures, and reshape the places you discover—your changes to a world persist.

Gear up

Wield a growing arsenal of plasma rifles, SMGs, rifles, scatter guns, and glowing plasma blades. Customize your exosuit with craftable styles and upgrades, and summon a glowing Echo orb to illuminate dark environments and help you traverse the unknown and find ore.

Survive the firefights

Worlds can erupt into Strikes, where dropships descend and waves of hostile creatures and armed Voiders close in. Face rushers, ranged attackers, and heavily armed enemies capable of taking cover and flanking your position.

Hold your ground—or make a run for your ship.

Beware the dark

Deep space hides wandering black holes. Real-time gravitational lensing bends the surrounding starfield around glowing accretion disks, while powerful gravity wells reach far into space.

Stray too close and the pull can become inescapable. Spiral inward and be stretched into a fine cosmic noodle—or be hurled across the galaxy through a wormhole.

Fly together

Host or join a game over LAN and explore the universe with friends.

Make it your own

Maintain multiple saved “universes,” each with its own seed, worlds, discoveries, and places to call home.

Pre-alpha disclaimer

Screenshots are captured from a pre-alpha build and represent the game’s current state of development. Features, visuals, gameplay systems, and content shown are subject to change and may not reflect the final product.

data.short_description: Take flight from planet surfaces to deep space with no loading screens. Explore a vast procedurally generated voxel universe, mine resources, build massive bases, battle alien creatures, and uncover virtually endless worlds. Play in first or third person.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Mac OSX Tahoe
  • Processor: Apple M2
